cui_curve_opts.comment: drags always snap to the grid (otherwise hold Shift)

cui_curve_result.name: changed
cui_curve_result.comment: a key moved, a handle or mode changed, or a key was added or removed

cui_curve_result.name: added
cui_curve_result.comment: index of the key added this frame, or -1

cui_curve_result.name: removed
cui_curve_result.comment: index the removed key had, or -1

cui_curve_result.name: hovered
cui_curve_result.comment: the pointer is over the plot:

cui_curve_result.name: hover_x
cui_curve_result.comment: the x under it and the curve's value there

cui_curve_result.name: hover_y
cui_curve_result.comment: the x under it and the curve's value there

cui_gradient_opts.name: selected
cui_gradient_opts.comment: the selected stop, kept by you; NULL keeps it in the editor

cui_gradient_result.name: changed
cui_gradient_result.comment: a stop moved, changed color, or was added or removed

cui_gradient_result.name: added
cui_gradient_result.comment: index of the stop added this frame, or -1

cui_gradient_result.name: removed
cui_gradient_result.comment: index the removed stop had, or -1

cui_timeline_clip.name: offset
cui_timeline_clip.comment: where the clip starts in its media; trimming the start moves it along

cui_timeline_track.name: depth
cui_timeline_track.comment: 0 top level; the deeper tracks after a track belong to it (a group)

cui_timeline_track.name: collapsed
cui_timeline_track.comment: a group hides its tracks (its chevron toggles this)

cui_timeline_track.name: muted
cui_timeline_track.comment: toggled by the row's buttons (.toggles); a locked track can't be edited

cui_timeline_track.name: locked
cui_timeline_track.comment: toggled by the row's buttons (.toggles); a locked track can't be edited

cui_timeline_track.name: color
cui_timeline_track.comment: series color 1..6; 0 takes the group's, or the next one at the top level

cui_timeline_track.name: keys
cui_timeline_track.comment: sorted by x: x is the time in seconds, y the value (may be NULL)

cui_timeline_track.name: key_selected
cui_timeline_track.comment: parallel to keys, kept by you; NULL: the keys are shown but not selectable

cui_timeline_track.name: clips
cui_timeline_track.comment: sorted by start, not overlapping (may be NULL)

cui_timeline_view.name: start
cui_timeline_view.comment: visible time range; end <= start fits the sequence

cui_timeline_view.name: end
cui_timeline_view.comment: visible time range; end <= start fits the sequence

cui_timeline_view.name: scroll
cui_timeline_view.comment: rows scrolled off the top, in points

cui_timeline_editor_opts.name: fps
cui_timeline_editor_opts.comment: frames per second, default 30: snapping, stepping and frame labels

cui_timeline_editor_opts.name: view
cui_timeline_editor_opts.comment: NULL keeps it in the editor

cui_timeline_editor_opts.name: in
cui_timeline_editor_opts.comment: a play range: with both set, markers to drag in the ruler and shading outside

cui_timeline_editor_opts.name: out
cui_timeline_editor_opts.comment: a play range: with both set, markers to drag in the ruler and shading outside

cui_timeline_editor_opts.name: current_track
cui_timeline_editor_opts.comment: the key last clicked or added, or -1; kept by you (NULL: in the editor)

cui_timeline_editor_opts.name: current_key
cui_timeline_editor_opts.comment: the key last clicked or added, or -1; kept by you (NULL: in the editor)

cui_timeline_editor_opts.name: track_width
cui_timeline_editor_opts.comment: track list, default 184; narrower (then icons only) on a narrow editor

cui_timeline_editor_opts.name: toggles
cui_timeline_editor_opts.comment: hide and lock buttons on every track

cui_timeline_editor_opts.name: free_drag
cui_timeline_editor_opts.comment: drags and scrubbing do not snap to frames

cui_timeline_editor_result.name: changed
cui_timeline_editor_result.comment: keys or clips moved, were added or removed, or a track flag changed

cui_timeline_editor_result.name: keys_moved
cui_timeline_editor_result.comment: selected keys moved this frame (drag or Alt+arrows)

cui_timeline_editor_result.name: added_track
cui_timeline_editor_result.comment: the key added this frame (double click), or -1

cui_timeline_editor_result.name: added_key
cui_timeline_editor_result.comment: the key added this frame (double click), or -1

cui_timeline_editor_result.name: removed_keys
cui_timeline_editor_result.comment: how many were removed this frame (Delete)

cui_timeline_editor_result.name: removed_clips
cui_timeline_editor_result.comment: how many were removed this frame (Delete)

cui_timeline_editor_result.name: clip_track
cui_timeline_editor_result.comment: the clip moved or trimmed this frame, or -1

cui_timeline_editor_result.name: clip
cui_timeline_editor_result.comment: the clip moved or trimmed this frame, or -1

cui_timeline_editor_result.name: toggled
cui_timeline_editor_result.comment: the track whose collapsed, muted or locked flag changed, or -1

cui_timeline_editor_result.name: hovered_track
cui_timeline_editor_result.comment: the key under the pointer, or -1

cui_timeline_editor_result.name: hovered_key
cui_timeline_editor_result.comment: the key under the pointer, or -1

cui_vertex.name: lx
cui_vertex.comment: position relative to the shape center, pixels

cui_vertex.name: ly
cui_vertex.comment: position relative to the shape center, pixels

cui_vertex.name: hw
cui_vertex.comment: half size of the shape, pixels

cui_vertex.name: hh
cui_vertex.comment: half size of the shape, pixels

cui_set_viewport.name: cui_set_viewport
cui_set_viewport.comment: Size of the drawable area in logical points, and the scale to pixels (2.0 on a typical retina display).

cui_begin_frame.name: cui_begin_frame
cui_begin_frame.comment: dt is the time since the previous frame in seconds.

cui_needs_redraw.name: cui_needs_redraw
cui_needs_redraw.comment: True while something animates or input is still settling. Event driven apps can sleep until the next input event when this is false.

cui_next_wakeup.name: cui_next_wakeup
cui_next_wakeup.comment: Seconds until CUI wants a frame (for caret blink, tooltips, toasts). Negative means "only on input".

cui_request_wakeup.name: cui_request_wakeup
cui_request_wakeup.comment: Asks for a frame within this many seconds even with no input, for things that change on a timer (a clock, polling, a countdown). Call it each frame while it is needed; an idle app then sleeps until the soonest one instead of redrawing continuously.

cui_frame_count.name: cui_frame_count
cui_frame_count.comment: CUI_API float cui_delta_time(cui_ctx *ui); seconds since the last frame

cui_input_key.name: cui_input_key
cui_input_key.comment: CUI_API void cui_input_scroll(cui_ctx *ui, float dx, float dy); in lines; +dy scrolls up

cui_input_file_hover.name: cui_input_file_hover
cui_input_file_hover.comment: Files dragged from the OS: hover while a drag is over the window (where the platform reports it), then the drop itself. Paths are UTF-8 and copied.

cui_dropped_file_count.name: cui_dropped_file_count
cui_dropped_file_count.comment: Files dropped this frame (dropzones claim theirs first).

cui_key_pressed.name: cui_key_pressed
cui_key_pressed.comment: Queries, useful for app level shortcuts.

cui_key_down.name: cui_key_down
cui_key_down.comment: Queries, useful for app level shortcuts. CUI_API bool cui_key_pressed(cui_ctx *ui, cui_key key); pressed this frame (with repeat)

cui_key_mods.name: cui_key_mods
cui_key_mods.comment: CUI_API bool cui_shortcut(cui_ctx *ui, int mods, cui_key key); e.g. cui_shortcut(ui, CUI_MOD_PRIMARY, CUI_KEY_K)

cui_wants_keyboard.name: cui_wants_keyboard
cui_wants_keyboard.comment: True when a text field has keyboard focus (so the app should not treat typing as shortcuts).

cui_theme_get.name: cui_theme_get
cui_theme_get.comment: The active theme. Edit it to customize; changes apply next frame. Theme changes through cui_set_theme/cui_set_accent animate smoothly.

cui_token_color.name: cui_token_color
cui_token_color.comment: CUI_API const cui_strings *cui_get_strings(cui_ctx *ui); what was set, or NULL

cui_oklch.name: cui_oklch
cui_oklch.comment: Color helpers. Mixing is done in OKLab, like CSS color-mix(in oklab).

cui_font_load_memory.name: cui_font_load_memory
cui_font_load_memory.comment: Load a TrueType/OpenType font. The data must stay alive if copy is false. Returns a font id, or -1 on failure.

cui_font_set_role.name: cui_font_set_role
cui_font_set_role.comment: Replace one of the built-in roles (e.g. use your brand font as CUI_FONT_BODY).

cui_font_add_fallback.name: cui_font_add_fallback
cui_font_add_fallback.comment: Glyphs missing from `font` are looked up in `fallback` (e.g. CJK, emoji).

cui_measure_text.name: cui_measure_text
cui_measure_text.comment: CUI_TEXT_SHAPING optionally shapes static RTL lines; see docs/integration.md. Container direction sets the paragraph base. Editing and explicit bidi formatting are unsupported; the shaper implements an experimental OpenType subset.

cui_separator.name: cui_separator
cui_separator.comment: CUI_API void cui_gap(cui_ctx *ui, float size); fixed space

cui_card_end.name: cui_card_end
cui_card_end.comment: CUI_API bool cui_card_begin(cui_ctx *ui, const cui_card_opts *opts); returns true when clicked (hoverable)

cui_last_id.name: cui_last_id
cui_last_id.comment: The id and rectangle of the most recent component (for tooltips, popovers).

cui_get_rect.name: cui_get_rect
cui_get_rect.comment: Rectangle of any component or box id from the latest layout.

cui_label.name: cui_label
cui_label.comment: CUI_API void cui_heading(cui_ctx *ui, const char *text, int level); 1..4

cui_secondary.name: cui_secondary
cui_secondary.comment: CUI_API void cui_label(cui_ctx *ui, const char *text); medium weight

cui_muted.name: cui_muted
cui_muted.comment: CUI_API void cui_secondary(cui_ctx *ui, const char *text); secondary color

cui_code.name: cui_code
cui_code.comment: CUI_API void cui_muted(cui_ctx *ui, const char *text); small, muted

cui_kbd.name: cui_kbd
cui_kbd.comment: CUI_API void cui_code(cui_ctx *ui, const char *text); inline code

cui_link.name: cui_link
cui_link.comment: CUI_API void cui_kbd(cui_ctx *ui, const char *keys); keyboard keycap, e.g. "Ctrl K"

cui_icon_button_ex.name: cui_icon_button_ex
cui_icon_button_ex.comment: Square/round button with only an icon. Give it a tooltip so it has a name.

cui_slider_ex.name: cui_slider_ex
cui_slider_ex.comment: Elastic slider: the track stretches like rubber when dragged past its ends.

cui_input_ex.name: cui_input_ex
cui_input_ex.comment: Single line text field. Returns CUI_CHANGED / CUI_SUBMITTED (Enter) flags.

cui_textarea_ex.name: cui_textarea_ex
cui_textarea_ex.comment: Multi-line text area with word wrap.

cui_search_ex.name: cui_search_ex
cui_search_ex.comment: Search field with a search icon and a clear button.

cui_date_today.name: cui_date_today
cui_date_today.comment: typedef struct cui_date { int year, month, day; } cui_date; month 1..12

cui_pagination.name: cui_pagination
cui_pagination.comment: CUI_API int cui_breadcrumb(cui_ctx *ui, const char *const *items, int count); returns clicked index or -1

cui_stepper.name: cui_stepper
cui_stepper.comment: CUI_API bool cui_pagination(cui_ctx *ui, const char *id, int *page, int page_count); page is 0 based

cui_tour_ex.name: cui_tour_ex
cui_tour_ex.comment: What happened this frame: one of CUI_TOUR_*.

cui_context_menu_begin.name: cui_context_menu_begin
cui_context_menu_begin.comment: Context menu: opens on right click over the previous component.

cui_tooltip.name: cui_tooltip
cui_tooltip.comment: Tooltip for the previous component, shown after a short hover delay.

cui_dialog_begin.name: cui_dialog_begin
cui_dialog_begin.comment: Modal dialog. Shown while *open is true; closing sets it to false.

cui_dialog_footer_begin.name: cui_dialog_footer_begin
cui_dialog_footer_begin.comment: A right-aligned row for dialog actions.

cui_toast_ex.name: cui_toast_ex
cui_toast_ex.comment: Queue a toast. Returns a handle; cui_toast_action_clicked(handle) tells whether its action button was pressed.

cui_alert_ex.name: cui_alert_ex
cui_alert_ex.comment: Inline alert. Returns false once dismissed (when dismissible).

cui_empty_state_ex.name: cui_empty_state_ex
cui_empty_state_ex.comment: Empty state. Returns true when its action button is clicked.

cui_accordion_begin.name: cui_accordion_begin
cui_accordion_begin.comment: Accordion / disclosure. Content animates its height.

cui_virtual_list_begin.name: cui_virtual_list_begin
cui_virtual_list_begin.comment: Virtual list: only the visible rows are built, so lists with a million rows stay fast. Fills first/last with the visible range.

cui_table_row.name: cui_table_row
cui_table_row.comment: Begin a row. Returns true when the row is clicked.

cui_table_cell.name: cui_table_cell
cui_table_cell.comment: Next cell; put any components inside, or use cui_table_cell_text.

cui_image_destroy.name: cui_image_destroy
cui_image_destroy.comment: CUI_API cui_texture cui_image_load(cui_ctx *ui, const char *path, int *w, int *h); PNG/JPEG via stb_image

cui_image_viewer_ex.name: cui_image_viewer_ex
cui_image_viewer_ex.comment: Returns true when the view changed.

cui_cropper_ex.name: cui_cropper_ex
cui_cropper_ex.comment: Returns true when the crop changed.

cui_command_palette.name: cui_command_palette
cui_command_palette.comment: Spotlight style command palette. Returns the index of the chosen command, or -1. Open it with a shortcut: if (cui_shortcut(ui, CUI_MOD_PRIMARY, CUI_KEY_K)) open = true;

cui_otp_input.name: cui_otp_input
cui_otp_input.comment: One time code input: `length` boxes; code must hold length + 1 bytes. Returns true when all boxes are filled (once per change).

cui_button_group_begin.name: cui_button_group_begin
cui_button_group_begin.comment: Connected buttons. Put buttons between begin and end.

cui_copy_button.name: cui_copy_button
cui_copy_button.comment: Icon button that copies text to the clipboard and confirms with a check.

cui_password_strength.name: cui_password_strength
cui_password_strength.comment: Password strength meter (0 weak .. 4 strong). Returns the score.

cui_reorder_begin.name: cui_reorder_begin
cui_reorder_begin.comment: Reorderable list: drag rows to reorder. `order` holds your item indices in display order and is rewritten when a row is dropped. Build the rows in display order: for (i...) cui_reorder_item(ui, i) { draw item order[i] }. Returns true on the frame the order changes.

cui_progress_ring.name: cui_progress_ring
cui_progress_ring.comment: Circular progress with the value in the middle.

cui_theme_switcher.name: cui_theme_switcher
cui_theme_switcher.comment: Theme switcher: light, dark and (optionally) system, as a compact icon segmented control. mode is 0 light, 1 dark, 2 system. Light and dark are applied for you; for system call cui_set_theme with the OS setting. Returns true when mode changed.

cui_theme_toggle.name: cui_theme_toggle
cui_theme_toggle.comment: Sun and moon icon button that toggles the theme with a morph.

cui_data_grid_cell.name: cui_data_grid_cell
cui_data_grid_cell.comment: CUI_API bool cui_data_grid_row(cui_ctx *ui, int row); true when the row was clicked

cui_data_grid_cell_text.name: cui_data_grid_cell_text
cui_data_grid_cell_text.comment: CUI_API void cui_data_grid_cell(cui_ctx *ui); next cell; put components inside

cui_data_grid_cell_edit.name: cui_data_grid_cell_edit
cui_data_grid_cell_edit.comment: Editable text cell: double click (or Enter on the cursor row) to edit, Enter or clicking away commits, Esc reverts. True when committed.

cui_data_grid_edit.name: cui_data_grid_edit
cui_data_grid_edit.comment: The same editable text, inside the current cell (after an avatar, say).

cui_tree_cell.name: cui_tree_cell
cui_tree_cell.comment: Tree cell: indentation, a disclosure chevron and a label, for tree tables (use it in a table or grid cell). Returns true when *open toggled.

cui_tree_table_row.name: cui_tree_table_row
cui_tree_table_row.comment: The next row in view: returns its node, or -1 when done. Then build its cells: cui_tree_table_name first, then cui_data_grid_cell(_text).

cui_tree_table_name.name: cui_tree_table_name
cui_tree_table_name.comment: The first cell: indentation, guides, the chevron, an icon and the name (cut short with a tooltip of the whole name when it does not fit).

cui_tree_table_end.name: cui_tree_table_end
cui_tree_table_end.comment: CUI_API int cui_tree_table_depth(cui_ctx *ui); depth of the current row, 0 at the top

cui_tree_sort.name: cui_tree_sort
cui_tree_sort.comment: Sorts every sibling list (stable) by cmp, relinking the nodes. Returns the new first top level node.

cui_path_bar_menu_begin.name: cui_path_bar_menu_begin
cui_path_bar_menu_begin.comment: True while the menu of separator *segment is showing: build menu items for the children of that segment, then call cui_path_bar_menu_end.

cui_file_browser_ex.name: cui_file_browser_ex
cui_file_browser_ex.comment: path: the folder shown, yours; the browser writes it as you move around.

cui_file_picker_ex.name: cui_file_picker_ex
cui_file_picker_ex.comment: True once, with the chosen path in out, when the dialog is confirmed; *open turns false then, or on Cancel and Esc.

cui_markdown_apply_task.name: cui_markdown_apply_task
cui_markdown_apply_task.comment: Writes a reported task toggle into text ('x' or ' ' between the brackets). Returns false when nothing was toggled or text no longer has a box there.

cui_code_editor_goto.name: cui_code_editor_goto
cui_code_editor_goto.comment: On the editor's next frame: put the caret at a line and column (1 based), focus the editor and scroll there. Call from the same id scope.

cui_code_editor_select.name: cui_code_editor_select
cui_code_editor_select.comment: On the next frame: select bytes anchor..cursor, focus and scroll there.

cui_code_editor_find.name: cui_code_editor_find
cui_code_editor_find.comment: Opens the find bar with query and selects the next match (NULL closes).

cui_candlestick_ex.name: cui_candlestick_ex
cui_candlestick_ex.comment: Returns the candle under the crosshair (pointer or keys), or -1.

cui_shimmer_text_ex.name: cui_shimmer_text_ex
cui_shimmer_text_ex.comment: Text with a highlight sweeping across it, for "Thinking..." states.

cui_typewriter_ex.name: cui_typewriter_ex
cui_typewriter_ex.comment: Types the text out. When the text grows (streamed tokens) it carries on from where it was; other changes start over. Returns true once complete.

cui_text_reveal_ex.name: cui_text_reveal_ex
cui_text_reveal_ex.comment: Words fade and rise into place one after another, when first shown and again whenever the text changes.

cui_word_rotate_ex.name: cui_word_rotate_ex
cui_word_rotate_ex.comment: One word at a time; the next one rolls up into place and the width follows.

cui_number_roll_ex.name: cui_number_roll_ex
cui_number_roll_ex.comment: A figure whose changed digits roll into place: up when the value rises, down when it falls, a beat apart from the left; unchanged characters stay still. Pass the formatted text ("$64,210", "1.2k"); digits are tabular.

cui_kanban_card_begin.name: cui_kanban_card_begin
cui_kanban_card_begin.comment: CUI_API bool cui_kanban_column_begin_ex(cui_ctx *ui, const char *title, int card_count, const cui_kanban_column_opts *opts); true: "+" clicked

cui_kanban_card_end.name: cui_kanban_card_end
cui_kanban_card_end.comment: CUI_API bool cui_kanban_card_begin(cui_ctx *ui, int card_id); true when clicked

cui_range_calendar.name: cui_range_calendar
cui_range_calendar.comment: One or two months side by side; click a start and an end.

cui_date_from_days.name: cui_date_from_days
cui_date_from_days.comment: CUI_API int cui_date_to_days(cui_date d); days since 1970-01-01

cui_time_dial.name: cui_time_dial
cui_time_dial.comment: Time dial: a clock face. Drag the hand to set hours, then minutes.

cui_level_meter_ex.name: cui_level_meter_ex
cui_level_meter_ex.comment: Returns true when the clip light was clicked to clear it.

cui_avatar_upload.name: cui_avatar_upload
cui_avatar_upload.comment: Avatar upload: a round avatar that takes a dropped image, with a camera badge on hover. Returns 1 when *image changed, -1 when clicked (browse), 0 otherwise. A dropped image is loaded with cui_image_load.

cui_node_begin_ex.name: cui_node_begin_ex
cui_node_begin_ex.comment: A node at canvas position (*x, *y), updated while it is dragged. Returns true while the node is selected. typedef struct cui_node_opts { int _; float width; const char *icon; } cui_node_opts; width default 184

cui_node_content_begin.name: cui_node_content_begin
cui_node_content_begin.comment: A row for ordinary components. They are laid out at 100% and scaled with the view, so their text is sharpest at 100% zoom and below.

cui_node_link.name: cui_node_link
cui_node_link.comment: A link from an output pin to an input pin. Returns true while it is selected.

cui_node_link_created.name: cui_node_link_created
cui_node_link_created.comment: What the user did this frame, one event per call; call them after cui_node_editor_begin (and up to the end of the frame).

cui_status_bar_item_ex.name: cui_status_bar_item_ex
cui_status_bar_item_ex.comment: A small clickable item ("Ln 12, Col 4", "UTF-8"). Returns true when clicked.

cui_dock_save.name: cui_dock_save
cui_dock_save.comment: Saved layout: one line, e.g. dock1 h0.22([*Scene tree,Assets],v0.7([*Viewport],[*Log,-Console])) h splits side by side and v stacks, the number is the first child's share, [..] is a leaf's tabs in order, * the selected tab, - a closed panel; a backslash escapes , [ ] ( ) and itself in names. cui_dock_save returns the full length (as snprintf does) and writes what fits, or 0 when there is no layout. cui_dock_load replaces the layout (and sets each panel's *open from it on its next frame); names it does not know yet are kept for when they appear. Malformed text returns false and changes nothing.

cui_inspector_group.name: cui_inspector_group
cui_inspector_group.comment: A folding group header. Build its rows only when this returns true (it stays true while the group animates closed). open may be NULL for a plain section that does not fold.

cui_prop_color_ex.name: cui_prop_color_ex
cui_prop_color_ex.comment: A swatch and hex value that opens the color picker.

cui_prop_vec_ex.name: cui_prop_vec_ex
cui_prop_vec_ex.comment: Compact X, Y (Z, W) scrub fields side by side; value holds 2, 3 or 4 floats.

cui_log_append_text.name: cui_log_append_text
cui_log_append_text.comment: Appends len bytes (-1: up to the terminator) stamped with time.

cui_log_get.name: cui_log_get
cui_log_get.comment: Line i (0 = oldest), or NULL when out of range. *text is terminated (and len bytes long).

cui_log_view_ex.name: cui_log_view_ex
cui_log_view_ex.comment: Toolbar: level filters, a search field that filters and highlights, Follow (keeps the newest line in view; scrolling up turns it off, reaching the bottom turns it back on), Copy (selected lines, or all shown) and Clear. Click a line to select it, Shift+click for a range; with the list focused, arrows move, Shift+arrows extend, Ctrl+A selects all, Ctrl+C copies, Esc clears the selection, End follows again.

cui_terminal_printf.name: cui_terminal_printf
cui_terminal_printf.comment: CUI_API void cui_terminal_write(cui_terminal_buffer *t, const char *data, int len); len -1: up to the terminator

cui_emoji_font_load_file.name: cui_emoji_font_load_file
cui_emoji_font_load_file.comment: ---- Emoji ---- Color emoji come from an emoji font: the system's (cui_emoji_font_load_system, which the picker calls by itself when nothing is loaded) or one the app ships. Bitmap color fonts (sbix as on macOS, CBDT as on Linux and Android) and layered ones (COLR version 0, as on Windows) are read, as is a plain outline font for one-color emoji. Sequences with skin tones, joined people and flags are looked up through the font's ligatures. Big fonts are read from the file as needed rather than loaded whole. Drawn emoji are kept in one texture and reused.

cui_draw_emoji.name: cui_draw_emoji
cui_draw_emoji.comment: CUI_API bool cui_emoji_supported(cui_ctx *ui, const char *utf8, int len); the font (or platform) can draw it

cui_hex_view_ex.name: cui_hex_view_ex
cui_hex_view_ex.comment: sel may be NULL: the view then keeps the selection itself.

cui_hex_view_goto.name: cui_hex_view_goto
cui_hex_view_goto.comment: Go to offset: on the view's next frame its cursor moves to offset, that byte becomes the selection and it scrolls into view (to the middle when it was out of sight). Wire a "Go to" field to it; it is safe to call every frame.

cui_flame_graph_ex.name: cui_flame_graph_ex
cui_flame_graph_ex.comment: selected: index into spans, -1 for none (may be NULL).

cui_flame_sort.name: cui_flame_sort
cui_flame_sort.comment: Sorts spans into the order the graph needs: by depth, then start (longer first on ties).

cui_flame_span_rect.name: cui_flame_span_rect
cui_flame_span_rect.comment: Where a span was drawn in the latest frame, in points (zero size when out of view). flame is the graph's id: cui_last_id(ui) right after the call.

cui_curve_eval.name: cui_curve_eval
cui_curve_eval.comment: The curve's value at x: exactly what the editor draws. keys sorted by x.

cui_gradient_eval.name: cui_gradient_eval
cui_gradient_eval.comment: The color at t: exactly what the ramp shows (each channel, alpha too, interpolated in sRGB between the stops on either side; the end colors continue past the first and last stop).

cui_timeline_editor_ex.name: cui_timeline_editor_ex
cui_timeline_editor_ex.comment: time: the playhead in seconds (may be NULL).

cui_draw_circle.name: cui_draw_circle
cui_draw_circle.comment: CUI_API void cui_draw_polygon(cui_ctx *ui, const cui_vec2 *points, int count, cui_color color); convex

cui_state.name: cui_state
cui_state.comment: Persistent per-id storage for your own components (zeroed on first use). State not used for about 300 frames is freed (and zeroed again if it comes back), so it suits what can be rebuilt. For resources held in it, such as textures, set a function that frees them: it runs when the state goes or the context is destroyed.

cui_animate.name: cui_animate
cui_animate.comment: Animation helpers. Values move toward target with a spring and request frames while moving. Reduced motion makes them snap.

cui_animate_spring.name: cui_animate_spring
cui_animate_spring.comment: Animation helpers. Values move toward target with a spring and request frames while moving. Reduced motion makes them snap. CUI_API float cui_animate(cui_ctx *ui, cui_id id, float target); smooth, no overshoot

cui_get_draw_data.name: cui_get_draw_data
cui_get_draw_data.comment: Valid after cui_end_frame until the next cui_begin_frame.
